stem.en: A client with a high-output ileostomy has pH 7.29, PaCO2 29 mm Hg, HCO3 14 mEq/L, sodium 138 mEq/L, and chloride 112 mEq/L. Use: anion gap = Na − (Cl + HCO3); normal anion gap = 8–12 mEq/L; expected PaCO2 = 1.5(HCO3) + 8 ± 2 mm Hg.
stem.zh: 一名高输出回肠造口患者的结果为：pH 7.29、PaCO2 29 mm Hg、HCO3 14 mEq/L、钠 138 mEq/L、氯 112 mEq/L。使用以下公式：阴离子间隙 = Na −（Cl + HCO3）；正常阴离子间隙 = 8–12 mEq/L；预期 PaCO2 = 1.5(HCO3) + 8 ± 2 mm Hg。

clozeStem.en: These results show {{q16_d1}} caused by {{q16_d2}}, with {{q16_d3}}.
clozeStem.zh: 这些结果显示{{q16_d1}}，由{{q16_d2}}引起，并伴有{{q16_d3}}。

options.en: high-anion-gap metabolic acidosis
options.zh: 高阴离子间隙代谢性酸中毒

options.en: normal-anion-gap metabolic acidosis
options.zh: 正常阴离子间隙代谢性酸中毒

options.en: primary respiratory alkalosis
options.zh: 原发性呼吸性碱中毒

options.en: intestinal bicarbonate loss from the ileostomy
options.zh: 回肠造口导致的肠道碳酸氢盐丢失

options.en: lactic acid accumulation from shock
options.zh: 休克导致的乳酸堆积

options.en: carbon dioxide retention from hypoventilation
options.zh: 低通气导致的二氧化碳潴留

options.en: appropriate respiratory compensation
options.zh: 适当的呼吸性代偿

options.en: a superimposed respiratory alkalosis
options.zh: 合并呼吸性碱中毒

options.en: a superimposed respiratory acidosis
options.zh: 合并呼吸性酸中毒

stem.en: A capable inpatient tells the nurse, “My close friend is the person I want to visit and support me.” Staff plan to exclude the friend solely because the friend is not legally related to the client. No safety restriction is currently in effect.
stem.zh: 一名具有决定能力的住院患者告诉护士：“我希望我的亲密朋友来探视并支持我。”工作人员仅因该朋友与患者没有法律亲属关系而计划拒绝其探视。目前没有实施任何安全限制。

options.en: honor the client’s designation of the friend as a visitor
options.zh: 尊重患者指定该朋友为探视者的决定

options.en: require the visitor to prove a legal family relationship
options.zh: 要求探视者证明其与患者存在法律亲属关系

options.en: allow the client’s relatives to choose all permitted visitors
options.zh: 由患者亲属决定所有获准探视者

options.en: the friend does not hold healthcare power of attorney
options.zh: 该朋友没有医疗授权委托书

options.en: a staff member is uncomfortable with nonrelative visitors
options.zh: 工作人员对非亲属探视者感到不自在

options.en: a clinically necessary or otherwise reasonable restriction applies consistently and is explained
options.zh: 存在临床必要或其他合理限制，且该限制被一致执行并得到说明

stem.en: A client with dysarthria is alert and has decision-making capacity. The client uses a speech-generating device and communicates slowly. For each proposed staff behavior, indicate whether it supports the client’s communication rights and autonomy.
stem.zh: 一名构音障碍患者意识清醒并具有决定能力。患者使用语音生成设备，沟通速度较慢。请判断每项工作人员行为是否支持患者的沟通权利和自主性。

rows.en: Ask the client which communication method works best.
rows.zh: 询问患者哪种沟通方式最有效。

rows.en: Provide the speech-generating device and allow the client to use it.
rows.zh: 提供语音生成设备并允许患者使用。

rows.en: Allow enough time for the client to complete each response.
rows.zh: 给予患者足够时间完成每次回答。

rows.en: Address questions directly to the client.
Respectfully ask the client to repeat or clarify an unclear word.
rows.zh: 对不清楚的词语，礼貌地请患者重复或澄清。

rows.en: Finish the client’s sentences to keep the interview moving.
rows.zh: 为了加快访谈进度，替患者说完句子。

rows.en: Direct all questions to the companion because communication is faster.
rows.zh: 因为沟通更快，把所有问题都问陪同者。

rows.en: Treat impaired speech as evidence that the client cannot make decisions.
rows.zh: 把言语受损视为患者不能作出决定的证据。

stem.en: Day and night shifts repeatedly accuse each other of failing to restock a time-critical airway cart. No client is currently deteriorating. An objective audit shows that responsibility changes at 1900, but the handoff checklist names no owner and includes no verification step. Complete the bowtie.
stem.zh: 日班和夜班反复互相指责未补充需要及时备齐的气道车。目前没有患者病情恶化。客观审计显示，责任在1900交接，但交接清单没有指定负责人，也没有核实步骤。完成蝴蝶结题。

condition.en: Role and process ambiguity at shift handoff
condition.zh: 交班时的角色与流程不明确
已证实的全院物资短缺

condition.en: A knowledge deficit about airway equipment
condition.zh: 对气道设备的知识不足

actions.en: Send separate warning emails to each shift
actions.zh: 分别向每个班次发送警告邮件

actions.en: Hold a joint day-night huddle using the audit facts
actions.zh: 根据审计事实召开日夜班联合短会

actions.en: Revise the handoff to name an owner and require closed-loop verification
actions.zh: 修改交接流程，指定负责人并要求闭环核实

actions.en: Discipline the most recent nurse who signed the checklist
actions.zh: 处分最近在清单上签字的护士

actions.en: Wait for another omission before changing the process
actions.zh: 等再次发生遗漏后再改变流程

parameters.en: Completion of the new owner-and-verification handoff check
parameters.zh: 新的负责人及核实交接检查完成率

parameters.en: Total unit overtime unrelated to restocking
parameters.zh: 与补货无关的科室总加班时间
气道车物资遗漏是否再次发生

parameters.en: Number of informal complaints about the other shift
parameters.zh: 对另一班次的非正式抱怨次数

stem.en: A client experiencing intimate-partner stalking asks the clinic to send appointment reminders only to a new email address and not to the home telephone or mailing address.
stem.zh: 一名遭受亲密伴侣跟踪的患者要求诊所只把预约提醒发送到新的电子邮箱，不要发送到家庭电话或邮寄地址。

clozeStem.en: This is a request for {{q05_request}}; the nurse should {{q05_action}}.

options.en: amendment of a disputed diagnosis
options.zh: 修改有争议的诊断

options.en: confidential communications by an alternative means or location
options.zh: 通过替代方式或地点进行保密通信

options.en: immediate access to the complete medical record
options.zh: 立即访问完整医疗记录

options.en: continue all existing reminder channels until the client obtains a court order
options.zh: 在患者取得法院命令前继续使用所有现有提醒渠道

options.en: route and document the request through the covered entity’s confidential-communications process and stop using the unsafe channels as directed
options.zh: 按照受监管实体的保密通信流程转交并记录该请求，并按要求停止使用不安全渠道

options.en: require the client to prove the stalking before changing contact methods
options.zh: 要求患者证明遭跟踪后才改变联系方式

stem.en: A client will leave today on outpatient parenteral antimicrobial therapy (OPAT). Infusion supplies will arrive before the first home dose. The prescribed plan is a complete blood count and metabolic panel every Monday and Thursday, but no recipient is named for the results. No clinician or team has accepted responsibility for the OPAT course, and follow-up is not booked. Complete the bowtie.
stem.zh: 一名患者今天将带院外静脉抗菌治疗（OPAT）出院。输注用品将在首次居家用药前送达。医嘱监测计划为每周一和周四进行全血细胞计数和代谢检查，但没有指定结果接收者。没有临床医生或团队接受OPAT疗程责任，随访也未预约。完成蝴蝶结题。

condition.zh: 不安全且无人负责的OPAT过渡
已确认的即刻抗菌药过敏

actions.en: Confirm the OPAT or infectious-diseases clinician/team that accepts responsibility for the course
actions.zh: 确认接受疗程责任的OPAT或感染病临床医生/团队

actions.en: Replace the prescribed schedule with daily laboratory testing
actions.zh: 把医嘱计划改成每日化验

actions.en: Make the client solely responsible for finding a clinician after discharge
actions.zh: 让患者独自负责出院后寻找临床医生

actions.en: Wait for an abnormal result before assigning responsibility
actions.zh: 等出现异常结果后再指定责任人

actions.en: Transmit the antimicrobial regimen and the prescribed Monday/Thursday monitoring plan to that responsible clinician/team
actions.zh: 把抗菌方案和每周一/周四监测计划传递给该负责临床医生/团队

actions.en: Discharge because supply delivery alone makes the transition complete
actions.zh: 仅因用品已安排送达就出院

parameters.en: Attendance at follow-up and documented clinical assessment of the OPAT course
parameters.zh: 按时随访并记录对OPAT疗程的临床评估

parameters.en: Receipt and documented review of the scheduled laboratory results
parameters.zh: 按计划化验结果的接收和有记录的审阅

parameters.en: Number of calls the client makes to locate a clinician
parameters.zh: 患者为寻找临床医生拨打电话的次数

parameters.en: Completion of unprescribed daily laboratory tests
parameters.zh: 完成未开具的每日化验
